(a) The new three-body test (rockContacts.test.ts) fails if the rockDone skip is removed. I traced it by hand. After motion, a is at -29 and b at 4 (overlap 7), and a's turn moves each 3.5 apart (a -32.5, b 7.5). On c's turn, the r 60 rock overlaps b by 10 and is split 1 for c and 9 for b, so c ends at 78.5 and b at -1.5. That leaves a and b 31 apart, under 39. A second (b, a) resolution would change a.x, so the assertions catch it. (b) The r 15 test asserts both velocities: share(ms)=60, giving the ship -60, and share(mk)=240, giving the rock +40. Swapping is/ik would swap those values and fail. (c) The 40 u/s static ram test now asserts the hp drop (10/40)·1800/(900+r²), so it would fail if case 2 dropped ram damage.
